problem.statement: Test whether a low-speed delivery robot can yield to pedestrians and return to a marked bay without blocking the accessible route.
problem.public_interest: Protect walking continuity, emergency access and the right to refuse an embodied-device test.
evidence_refs: proposal.md#v1.8 评审可见证据层：定位、功能、节点与公共性一页回读

place.non_ai_path: ordinary walking route, paper notice and human delivery alternative

data.purpose: synthetic fixture for a bounded safety rehearsal; no real delivery transaction
data.personal_data: none; no face, voice, device identifier or individual trajectory
data.retention: delete the synthetic event log after the human review packet is reproduced

rights.notice: SANDBOX / SYNTHETIC DATA / NO LIVE DELIVERY
rights.opt_out: the ordinary walking route remains open and a person can ask for the test to stop
rights.appeal: report the event record to the human reviewer; no automated decision affects a person
rights.accessibility: paper notice, visible stop state and non-digital route are mandatory
rights.deletion: delete the synthetic log without deleting any public-service record

operations.on_call_role: human spotter with authority to stop
operations.fallback: hand cart and human delivery; the accessible route always wins
operations.maintenance_owner: unassigned concept role; must be named before any trial
operations.exit_asset_plan: remove the device, restore the ordinary bay, retain only schema and review note

handoff.output_object: EmbodiedSafetyEvidence: synthetic run log plus human comparison
handoff.next_gate: independent accessibility and safety review before any limited trial

disclaimer: Synthetic concept-only example. It demonstrates a reversible evidence contract, not robot performance, public acceptance, legal compliance or deployment approval.
